status.headline: No Proving Ground field has been entered yet.
status.body: Once the July–October performance window closes, the four entrants for each show/division can be added here, followed by standings, block results, Combat Points, finalists, and the final December to Remember challenger.

blocks.description: Four Ascension men compete in round-robin block matches.
Four Ascension women compete in round-robin block matches.
Four Revolt men compete in round-robin block matches.
Four Revolt women compete in round-robin block matches.

tournamentFlow.title: Performance Window
tournamentFlow.description: July through October records, PPV results, and division performance determine the Proving Ground pool.

tournamentFlow.title: Qualification Slots
tournamentFlow.description: Each show/division fills four spots through W/L average, PPV performance, and the Wildcard Play-In.

tournamentFlow.title: Round-Robin Block
tournamentFlow.description: Every entrant faces the other three wrestlers in their block, creating six total block matches.

tournamentFlow.title: Combat Points Table
tournamentFlow.description: Wins, finish methods, speed, blood, and draws shape the standings.

tournamentFlow.title: PPV Final
tournamentFlow.description: The top two point scorers advance to the Proving Grounds PPV final.

tournamentFlow.title: December Title Shot
tournamentFlow.description: The tournament winner earns a trophy and a championship opportunity at December to Remember.

qualificationPaths.title: #1 W/L Average
qualificationPaths.description: The top-ranked wrestler by win-loss average from the July–October performance window earns automatic entry.

qualificationPaths.title: #2 W/L Average
qualificationPaths.description: The second-ranked wrestler by win-loss average from the July–October performance window earns automatic entry.

qualificationPaths.title: Best PPV Performer
qualificationPaths.description: The strongest PPV performer from July–October earns entry. If already qualified, the slot rolls to the next-best PPV performer.

qualificationPaths.title: Wildcard Play-In
qualificationPaths.description: Four eligible wrestlers ranked #3–#12 are randomly drawn into a one-night mini bracket. The winner earns the final block spot.

combatPoints.label: Win
combatPoints.note: Base reward for winning a block match.

combatPoints.label: Draw
combatPoints.note: Both wrestlers receive one point if the match ends without a winner.

combatPoints.label: Loss
combatPoints.note: No points are awarded for losing the match.

combatPoints.label: Pinfall / Submission Win
combatPoints.note: Bonus point added when the winner scores the fall by pinfall or submission.

combatPoints.label: KO Win
combatPoints.note: Bonus reward for ending the match by knockout.

combatPoints.label: Count-Out Win
combatPoints.note: A count-out victory gives no total points in Proving Ground scoring.

combatPoints.label: DQ Win
combatPoints.note: A disqualification victory gives no total points in Proving Ground scoring.

combatPoints.label: Under 20 Minutes
combatPoints.note: Speed bonus. Time bonuses are tiered, not stacked.

combatPoints.label: Under 15 Minutes
combatPoints.note: Speed bonus. This replaces the under-20 bonus.

combatPoints.label: Under 10 Minutes
combatPoints.note: Maximum speed bonus. This replaces the under-15 and under-20 bonuses.

combatPoints.label: Draw Blood
combatPoints.note: Awarded to any wrestler who makes their opponent bleed, win or lose.
